segments.title: A 4,000-year-old wall. Built against WHAT?
segments.say: This wall in Morocco is about four thousand years old. Nobody knows what its builders feared.

segments.title: North Africa's oldest of its kind
segments.say: It's North Africa's oldest known defensive wall outside the Nile Valley.

segments.title: A farming hub
segments.say: Beside it, dozens of pits likely stored grain. Far more than they needed.

segments.title: "We don't know"
segments.say: The lead researcher says they don't know what it protected against. Land? Grain? Power?

segments.title: Published Sept 2026
segments.sub: Italy, Morocco + England team in **Libyan Studies**
segments.say: A team from Italy, Morocco and England published it in September.
What were they afraid of? Comment below.
recap: Oldest of its kind outside the Nile Valley
